metadataRaw.title: Tailbone Pain Relief IN SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to fix tailbone pain at home. 

A common cause of tailbone pain (also known as coccydynia or coccygodynia) is due strain and inflammation in the muscles that support the coccyx (tailbone) and sacrum. This is commonly seen with prolonged sitting and poor posture.

Over time this strain leads to tightness, weakness, instability, and pain around the tailbone. 

To fix this, this video will be broken up into two sperate parts that will focus on lengthening and strengthening these muscles. To get the best results, go through all exercises and use what gives you the most relief.

All of the exercises can be done at home, require no special equipment, and may give quick tailbone pain relief... even within 30 seconds.

Watch now and get rid of tailbone pain for good!
